claim: A routine reachable from both an ISR and ordinary code, or called inside other drawing, must save and restore its own incoming IFF; compare both IFF states.

evidence.text: Preserve its incoming IFF and protect shared hook state before the first write; compare both IFF states.
Nested full plots have separate outer IFF and speed latches; tests cover both IFF states.
Sprite update saves entry IFF, restores it after; the recording exercises 19 entries with interrupts enabled.
